lines.trans: Nina, stop fussing around in the kitchen!
Come on, let us sit for a moment before the road.
I have already packed all our things.
You have certainly ruined those children's lives!
How will you live in Siberia?
Klavdiya Viktorovna, can you be quiet for at least a minute?
Nina, check the tickets, passports, and money.
All our documents are lying in the bag.
The taxi has already driven up to our house.
That is it, we take the suitcases and go out!
I will miss you very much.
Thank you for everything, dear neighbor.
Farewell, our old communal apartment!
Our completely new life is beginning.

meanings.note: document giving the holder a right to travel or enter

examples.trans: Listen here, we bought tickets after all!

examples.text: Я купил два билета в кино.
examples.trans: I bought two tickets to the cinema.

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

возиться.gloss: to fiddle with, potter about, bustle

meanings.en: to potter about, fiddle, fuss over

examples.trans: Stop fussing around in the kitchen!
The children pottered with the construction set for a long time.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: affectionate or colloquial form for child

examples.trans: There's a new building on Simashko Street.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.trans: I live in a communal flat.
I was born and grew up here.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: We lived in a communal flat.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: to lie, to be lying down, to rest

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
The book is lying on the table.
I'll be there in ten minutes.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: carries address registration and marriage stamps in Russia

examples.trans: You need a stamp in the passport.

meanings.en: to cross out, ruin or wipe out

examples.trans: You certainly ruined those children's lives!

examples.text: Один неверный шаг перечеркнул все планы.
examples.trans: One wrong step ruined all plans.

подъехать.gloss: to drive up, arrive by car

examples.trans: I can drive over there too!

meanings.en: to be quiet, to keep silent for a bit
meanings.note: politer or softer than молчать in commands

examples.trans: Let's be quiet for a moment.

присесть.gloss: to sit down (for a moment), to take a seat

meanings.en: to sit down, to have a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on the chair.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

скучать.gloss: to miss, yearn for, feel bored

examples.text: Я буду очень скучать по вам.
examples.trans: I will miss you very much.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Давайте я вам помогу с сумкой.
examples.trans: Let me help you with your bag.
She put the keys into her bag.
The taxi already drove up to the house.
We called a cab to the station.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

хотя.gloss: even if, at least (with бы); although

meanings.note: нужно хотя бы поговорить = we need at least to talk

examples.text: Нужно хотя бы поговорить с ними.
examples.trans: We need at least to talk with them.
We take the suitcases and go out.

examples.text: Он аккуратно сложил одежду в чемодан.
examples.trans: He neatly placed his clothes in the suitcase.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
